notes.title: Sexy Slime Party Question Collection
notes.notes: [p]Dear Slime Party players: [/p][p]First of all, thank you all for purchasing and supporting "Sexy Slime Party". [/p][p]In order to provide you with a better and more enjoyable gaming experience, we are now launching a question collection activity for all players. No matter what difficulties you encounter during the game, or if you have any questions about the gameplay, content, graphics, etc., we welcome your feedback. Please provide the text you want to be translated.[/p][p]I. Scope of Collection [/p][p]Gameplay: For instance, questions related to the battle mechanism of Slimes, the cultivation system, level design, etc. [/p][p]Game content: including plot comprehension, questions related to levels or characters [/p][p]Game graphics and sound effects: Issues related to display effects, sound settings, etc. [/p][p]Game technical issues: such as login difficulties, crashes, network connection problems, etc. [/p][p]II. Feedback Methods [/p][p]Please join the QQ communication group for this game: 959340169 [/p][p]Problem description: Clearly and in detail explain the problem or question you have encountered. Please provide the text you want to be translated.[/p][p]Occurrence time: The specific time when the problem occurred. Please provide the text you want to be translated.[/p][p]We highly value every player's voice. Your questions will help us continuously optimize the game and make "Sexy Slime Party" even more perfect. We look forward to everyone's active participation! Please provide the text you want to be translated.[/p][p]The "Sexy Slime Party" operation team [/p][p]\[September 1, 2025][/p]
